planets.name: HAT-P-32 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-32 with a 2.15-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: HAT-P-32 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-32. Its orbit and size follow Wang et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname WANG_ET_AL__2019): disc_year 2011, disc_facility HATNet, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.150008197, pl_radj 1.98, pl_bmassj 0.68

quotes.title: HAT-P-32b
quotes.card: HAT-P-32b is a planet orbiting the G-type or F-type star HAT-P-32, which is approximately 950 light years away from Earth.
quotes.introduction: HAT-P-32b was first recognized as a possible planet by the planet-searching HATNet Project in 2004, although difficulties in measuring its radial velocity prevented astronomers from verifying the planet until after three years of observation.
